mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate directly elevates discount rates for equity valuation, compressing price-to-earnings multiples and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is rising, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 1.5%, it signals a sustained monetary tightening cycle that increases real borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 1.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate and decline in employment levels indicates a deteriorating labor market, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle economic expansions, rising housing starts (HOUST) signal sustained consumer demand and business investment, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods during late-cycle expansions when HOUST is rising, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) reflects robust manufacturing activity and economic growth, boosting corporate profits and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is rising, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 5.0%, it triggers expectations of aggressive monetary policy tightening, reducing equity valuations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 5.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) and high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 5.0%) signals a 'higher for longer' monetary policy stance, increasing recession risks and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: dual threat regime (high inflation + rate hikes)
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both FEDFUNDS is rising and CPIAUCSL > 5.0%, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During post-pandemic economic recoveries, strong employment growth (PAYEMS) indicates sustained consumer confidence and corporate hiring, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods during post-pandemic recoveries when PAYEMS is rising, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.
